skill.name: product-strategist
skill.description: Build product strategy artifacts, generate cascading OKRs, score alignment, and support planning for product leaders and teams.
skill.summary: Generate aligned product OKRs and strategy planning outputs for product leaders.
skill.author: alirezarezvani

security_audit.summary: The single static finding is a false positive. SKILL.md line 22 uses markdown backticks to document a local Python command, not Ruby or shell execution. No prompt injection or semantic abuse evidence was found.

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md line 22 uses markdown backticks to document a local Python command. The reviewed Python script does not execute subprocesses or shell commands.

content.value_statement: Product leaders need clear goal alignment across company, product, and teams. This skill generates OKR cascades, dashboards, and alignment scores from strategy templates.
actual_capabilities: Generates company OKRs from growth, retention, revenue, innovation, and operational strategy templates.
Cascades company objectives into product objectives owned by the Head of Product.
Creates team-level OKRs for Growth, Platform, Mobile, and Data teams.
Calculates vertical alignment, horizontal alignment, coverage, balance, and overall scores.
Prints a text dashboard that shows the company, product, and team OKR hierarchy.
limitations: Uses fixed built-in metrics unless the script is edited.
Does not connect to Jira, Asana, spreadsheets, or analytics tools.
Does not store OKR history or track progress over time.
Uses keyword matching for team relevance, so outputs need human review.

use_cases.title: Quarterly Planning
use_cases.description: Create company-to-team OKRs for a new planning cycle and review alignment before leadership approval.

use_cases.title: Alignment Review
use_cases.description: Generate an OKR hierarchy and alignment scores to find gaps across product teams.

use_cases.title: Strategy Translation
use_cases.description: Turn a company strategy theme into product objectives and team contributions.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Basic OKRs
prompt_templates.prompt: Use product-strategist to create growth OKRs that cascade from company level to product and team levels.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Strategy Themes
prompt_templates.prompt: Use product-strategist to compare retention and revenue OKR cascades for the next quarter.

prompt_templates.title: Review Team Alignment
prompt_templates.prompt: Use product-strategist to generate operational OKRs and explain the alignment scores for each level.

prompt_templates.title: Customize an OKR System
prompt_templates.scenario: Adapt the script for a specific organization
prompt_templates.prompt: Use product-strategist to propose script changes for custom teams, metrics, and strategy templates.

output_examples.input: Create growth-focused OKRs for quarterly planning.
output: Company objectives focus on user acquisition, new segments, and sustainable growth.
Product objectives translate the strategy into viral features, hypothesis validation, and product-led growth loops.
Team objectives assign relevant work to Growth, Platform, Mobile, and Data teams.
The dashboard includes alignment scores for vertical alignment, coverage, balance, and overall health.

output_examples.input: Assess whether product teams align to a retention strategy.
output: The output lists retention objectives at company and product levels.
Each team receives related objectives when keyword matching shows a relevant contribution.
The alignment score highlights whether objectives are covered and balanced across teams.

output_examples.input: Prepare an operational excellence planning draft.
output_examples.output: The skill creates operational OKRs, assigns product and team ownership, and summarizes alignment in a readable dashboard.

best_practices: Start with one strategy theme that matches the planning cycle.
Review every generated objective with leaders before publishing it.
Use alignment scores as decision support, not as automatic approval.
anti_patterns: Treating generated OKRs as final without stakeholder review.
Using default metrics when real baseline and target values are available.
Ignoring teams that do not match the built-in keyword rules.

faq.question: What strategy templates does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports growth, retention, revenue, innovation, and operational templates.

faq.question: Can it generate team-level OKRs?
faq.answer: Yes. It creates team OKRs for Growth, Platform, Mobile, and Data teams.

faq.question: Does it calculate alignment scores?
faq.answer: Yes. It calculates vertical alignment, horizontal alignment, coverage, balance, and overall scores.

faq.question: Can it export structured output?
faq.answer: Yes. The script can print structured OKR data when run with the json option.

faq.question: Does it integrate with product management tools?
faq.answer: No. It prints outputs locally and does not connect to external services.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: It is best for product leaders, product operations teams, and founders planning cross-team goals.
